title: Oqanjwe Igama Endlini Yomprofethi
intro: Endlini yesithunywa sokugcina, kwakuhlala umphefumulo ondaba yawo siqu yaba yisifundo saphezulu kubo bonke abakholwayo. Impilo yalo muntu yayixhumene kakhulu nomyalo oguqulayo owaguqula amasiko omphakathi unomphela, okwaphawula ushintsho olukhulu endleleni ukholo olwaluzochaza ngayo umndeni kanye nokuba yingxenye yawo.
clues: Igama lami lake lahlotshaniswa nozalo oluhloniphekile, kodwa iqiniso eliphakeme kamuva lalizocacisa izibopho zangempela zokholo.
Ngangingumuntu owathola umusa omkhulu ovela ku-Allah kanye nesithunywa saKhe, umusa owamenyezelwa obala eNcwadini.
Impilo yami yomshado yaba uvivinyo olubalulekile olwaluzoshintsha unomphela umbono wobudlelwano bokutholwa.
Yimi lowo icala lakhe laholela emyalweni kaNkulunkulu owavumela uMprofethi ukuba ashade nowesifazane ngemva kokuba sengihambile.
Ngendaba yami, umehluko phakathi komndeni wemvelo nowomndeni okhethiwe wenziwa wacaca kuzo zonke izizukulwane.
Ngingedwa phakathi kontanga yami ogama lakhe livela ngokucacile ekwambulweni kokugcina, hhayi njengomprofethi, kodwa njengenceku evivinyiwe futhi yahlonishwa.

outcome.label: Umphumela

outcome.answer: Ukuqedwa kokutholwa njengendlela yokwakha ubudlelwano begazi

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
